newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Grant Samuel launches management buyout fund.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Grant Samuel launches management buyout fund.

text.p: Corporate advisory firm and investment group Grant Samuel on Tuesday said it launched a fund which aimed to raise up to A$200 million from institutional investors and would focus on management buyouts.

Andrew Rothery, managing director of the fund which is to be called GS Private Equity Fund 1, said the fund would aim to provide a return 50 percent above the All Ordinaries accumulation index over its 10 year life.

Rothery, who is also managing director of Byvest Advisers Ltd, said the establishment of GS Private Equity follows the wind-down of the Byvest Equity fund, Australia's first fund which invested in management buyouts.

Rothery said private equity, or development capital, investment offered the prospect of higher returns than listed equity investments as well as an opportunity for investors to diversify their exposure.
"The primary focus will be on investing in later stage, established businesses where the investment will facilitate profitable growth or result in change of control of the business," he said.
"It is envisaged that target businesses will have total revenues or assets of not less than A$50 million and preferably more in the order of A$100 million."
Rothery said the fund would be primarily aimed at superannuation funds.
